options.reply: Chilaka flutters off and returns with a clue. Your first hint in this fight is free.
You roll up your sleeves. Clear it without any hints and you earn 3 bonus seeds.
You steady your breath and write three questions to ask the bug.

intro: The Typo Imp 👺 blocks the road.
“I hide one tiny slip in your very first program.”
Chilaka whispers: “Every bug has a reason. Find it, and it loses its power.”
win: The imp pops like a bubble. One small fix, and the whole program works.
Chilaka: “That is how you debug: calmly, one clue at a time.”

intro: The Gopher Gremlin 🐹 guards the last gate of the Grove.
“Write me a whole program that compiles, or go back to reading.”
Chilaka whispers: “Compile errors are just the compiler being kind. Read them from the top.”
win: The Gremlin nods and the gate opens.
Chilaka: “You wrote real Go. Not a snippet, a program.”

intro: The Tag Goblin 🏷 has scrambled a shop page. It looks fine at a glance.
“Can you find what I broke? Screen readers can.”
Chilaka whispers: “Look at the structure, not the colours.”
win: The goblin drops its tags and runs.
Chilaka: “Good HTML is the base of everything else on the web.”

intro: The Pixel Imp 🎨 wants a profile card, and it wants it neat.
“Rounded corners, spacing and a tidy row of tags. No pressure.”
Chilaka whispers: “Three rules. Do them one at a time.”
win: The imp admires the card and tips its tiny hat.
Chilaka: “That is real CSS. You can style anything now.”

intro: The Bug Wasp 🐝 buzzes around a blank page.
“You cannot build a working calculator. Not with empty boxes.”
Chilaka whispers: “Check the input first. Bad input is the wasp's favourite snack.”
win: The wasp buzzes off. The calculator works, even with empty boxes.
Chilaka: “Events, the page and edge cases, all in one. Well done.”

intro: The Query Hydra 🐉 has four heads: a CTE, a join, a window and a filter.
“Cut one head and two more appear.”
Chilaka whispers: “Build it in layers. Test each layer alone.”
win: The last head falls silent.
Chilaka: “Windows and CTEs are what analysts use every day. You have them.”

intro: The Report Wraith 📊 floats out of the owner's office with a long list of demands.
“Spend, city, rank. And no NULLs.”
Chilaka whispers: “One CTE for spend, then the rank. You have done each part before.”
win: The wraith folds into a neat spreadsheet and vanishes.
Chilaka: “That is a real report, built by you.”

intro: The Knot Spider 🕷️ drops from a tangle of pipes and loose quotes.
“Blank lines, junk, negatives... your script will choke on one of them.”
Chilaka whispers: “Check every line before you trust it. Skip what you cannot use.”
win: The spider unravels into one neat thread.
Chilaka: “Validation, totals and edge cases, in a dozen lines. Tidy work.”

intro: The Night Owl 🦉 watches the server room at 3 a.m.
“A script that cannot report failure is a script that hides it.”
Chilaka whispers: “Exit codes are how scripts talk to schedulers. Say the right number.”
win: The owl blinks twice and flies off. The nightly job is safe.
Chilaka: “Counts, top error and an honest exit status. That is a real tool.”
